asked.item: Fix My Automation button missing on failed Make.com request
Is it hidden on my plan (answered by the n8n-only availability)
What to do instead for Make.com failures

verdict.reason: The help pages state that Fix My Automation is n8n only and does not work for Make.com, and they give the manual checklist to use instead.

steps.text: The Fix My Automation button is only for n8n workflows and does not work for Make.com.
For Make.com, use the manual troubleshooting checklist instead.
Check that your Blotato API key, Account IDs, and Page/channel IDs are correct.
Open your Logs and click the request to see the full payload, error response, and which account it was sent to.
